content: Yesu yↄ̃a
Ɔ̃ Lua Nisĩna gɛ̀ ń Yesuo gbáau kɛ́ Ibiisi aà yↄ̃.
Yesu lɛyè fãanɛ ń gwãasĩnao e gↄↄ bla. Kɛ́ nↄana lɛ́ aà dɛ,
ↄ̃ kↄ̃nidepi sↄ̃̀aàzi à mɛ̀: Tó Lua Nɛ́n n ũ, o gbɛɛ beeↄ li pɛ̃ɛ ũ.
Yesu wèwà à mɛ̀: A kɛ̃a Lua taalau wà mɛ̀,

content.text: pↄblea yã́ ↄ̃ gbɛ̃nazĩna kuò adoo,
sema yã́ pↄ́ Lua lɛ́ o píi.

content: Ɔ̃ Ibiisi aà sɛ̀ gɛ̀ò Lua wɛ̃́lɛu, à aà zɛ̀ Lua kpɛ́ misonaa,
a òɛ̀: Tó Lua Nɛ́n n ũ, ǹ nzĩa zu zĩ́lɛ, asa a kɛ̃a láu Lua mɛ̀,

content.text: a n yã'o a malaikaↄnɛ aa ↄdama,

content: Yesu òɛ̀: A kɛ̃a Lua taalau lↄ wà mɛ̀,

content.text: ńsuli Dii n Lua lɛ ǹ gwao.

content: Ɔ̃ Ibiisi aà sɛ̀ gɛ̀ò lↄ gbɛ̀sĩsĩ lɛsĩ maamaa musu, à dṹnia bùsu píi ↄ̀lↄɛ̀ ń ń àizɛɛↄ
à mɛ̀: Má n gba beeↄ píiɛ, tó n wulɛ n gbɛɛu n misìilɛmɛɛ.
Ɔ̃ Yesu òɛ̀: Gɛ́i Setãu! Asa a kɛ̃a láu wà mɛ̀:
Ɔ̃ Ibiisi aà tò we sa, ↄ̃ malaikaↄ mↄ̀ dↄ̀aàlɛ.
Yesu ↄkpaa a zĩwa
Kɛ́ Yesu mà wà Zãa kũ̀ wa dàkpɛu, ↄ̃ à tà Galile.
I zↄ̃lɛ Nazalɛti lↄo, à gɛ̀ zↄ̃̀lɛ ísida saɛ Kapɛnaũɛ, Zabulↄni buiↄ ń Nɛfatali buiↄ bùsuu,
kɛ́ yã́ pↄ́ ãnabi Isaia ò kɛ yã́i à mɛ̀:

content.text: Zabulↄni buiↄ ń Nɛfatali buiↄ bùsu
za ísia oi e Yuudɛ̃ baale,
an gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ kú gusiauↄ gupua zↄ̃ↄ è,
gu dↄ̀ bùsu pↄ́ kú ga lɛ́zĩpi deↄnɛ sa.

content: Za gↄↄ bee Yesu nà waasokɛawa à mɛ̀: À nↄ̀sɛlilɛ, kpala pↄ́ bↄ̀ Lua kĩ́i kà kãi.
Kɛ́ Yesu lɛ́ dↄ Galile ísidai, à kpↄ̀wɛnaↄ è gbɛ̃ↄn pla, vĩ̀i ń dãunao, Simↄↄ pↄ́ wì mɛ Piɛɛ ń a dãuna Ãndeleeo. Aalɛ táalu zu ísidapi guu.
Ɔ̃ Yesu ònɛ́: À mↄ tɛmazi, mí á kɛ gbɛ̃wɛɛlɛnaↄ ũ.
Wegↄ̃ↄ aa ń táaluↄ tò we, aa bↄ̀ tɛaàzi.
Kɛ́ à gɛ̀ aɛ, à gbɛ̃ↄn pla pãleↄ è, vĩ̀i ń dãunao lↄ, Zebedee nɛ́ Zaaki ń a dãuna Zãao. Aa ku gó'ilɛna guu ń ń mae Zebedeepio, aalɛ ń táaluↄ kɛkɛ. Yesu ń sisi,
ↄ̃ aa ń mae tò gó guu wegↄ̃ↄ, aa bↄ̀ tɛaàzi.
Yesu ìↄ Galile bùsu kɛɛlɛ, ì yãdanɛ́ ń lousisikpɛↄ guu, ì kpala pↄ́ bↄ̀ Lua kĩ́i baokpa, ì gbɛ̃́ↄ gbã́gbã ń gyã bui píio ń kↄ̃̀ↄↄ píi.
Aà tↄ́ lì Sili bùsua píi, ↄ̃ wìↄ mↄɛ̀ ń gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ aalɛ gyã bui dasi ge wãwãkɛↄ ń tã́adeↄ ń gbakↄↄndeↄ ń ɛɛↄ píi, ↄ̃ ì ń gbã́gbã.
Wà bↄ̀ Galile ń Wɛ̃́lɛmɛnkwi bùsuo ń Yelusalɛũo ń Yudeo ń Yuudɛ̃ baaleo dasidasi, wà tɛ̀aàzi.
